qualification.details: Psychologist (Clinical Psychologist) (DE IC-RBSK) under NHM: Post-Graduate degree in Psychology or Clinical Psychology or Applied Psychology (full time course). Master of Philosophy in Clinical Psychology or Medical & Social Psychology obtained after completion of a full time course of two years which includes supervised clinical training from any University recognized by the University Grants Commission established under the University Grants Commission Act, 1956 and approved and recognized by the Rehabilitation Council of India Act, 1992. Early Interventionist - cum-Special Educator (DEIC-RBSK) under NHM: MSc in Disability studies (Early Intervention) with basic degree in occupational therapy (BOT)(full time course) OR Post graduate Diploma in Early Intervention (PGDEI) with basic degree in Occupational therapy (BOT)(full time course) OR B.Ed Special Education/Bachelor in Rehabilitation Science/Bachelor in intellectual disability (full time course). It would be necessary to pass an examination on early intervention domain to assess the basic knowledge of the child development process for continuation of services within 6 months of joining. Radiographer(NT EP) under NHM: 10+2 with science subjects (Physics, Chemistry & Biology) from a recognized board (full time course). B.Sc in Radiography (3 years) recognized by MCI (full time course) OR Diploma in Radiography (2 years) recognized by MCI (full time course) and One year experience in relevant field.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for NHM Chandigarh Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: www.nrhmchd.gov.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 10-09-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for NHM Chandigarh Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the NHM Chandigarh QUALIFIED CONTRACTUAL STAFF posts is 10-09-2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for QUALIFIED CONTRACTUAL STAFF posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 6 vacancies for QUALIFIED CONTRACTUAL STAFF posts released by NHM Chandigarh.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is Offline. Candidates need to send their applications to the specified address.

faq.question: Q4. What is the minimum qualification required for the Radiographer post?
faq.answer: The minimum qualification for the Radiographer post is 10+2 with science subjects and a Diploma in Radiography with one year of experience.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for the NHM Chandigarh contractual staff positions?
faq.answer: The age limit for all the posts is up to 60 years.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process will be based on a Written Test of 100 Marks.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary offered for the Psychologist post?
faq.answer: The salary offered for the Psychologist (Clinical Psychologist) post is Rs. 30,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q8. Where can I download the application form?
faq.answer: The application form can be downloaded from the official website of NHM Chandigarh: www.nrhmchd.gov.in.

faq.question: Q9. What documents need to be submitted with the application form?
faq.answer: Self-attested photocopies of certificates/testimonials (from matriculation onwards) and one recent attested passport size photograph are required.
